Project labels you will see on files and charts
The current historical experiment: does option

2026) that found no usable improvement. Its

Workstreams of the earlier programme: Phase 5
registered and read the thirty-minute study; Phase
8A recorded a small exploratory bridge; Phase 9
collected the sessions later reused here.
Saved revisions of RP4: v1 diagnosis, v2 data and
fitting repair, v3 refined option flow, v4 the
The three nested information sets: B0 market
history (29 predictors), B1 adds option state
The two ordered tests: H1 asks whether option
state beats market history; H2 asks whether option
flow beats option state, and only counts if H1
Realised variance over the next 30, 15 or 5
minutes. RV15 is the primary target of v4.
Numbered entries in the project's decision log:
the four-model average as a secondary candidate.
Labels identify parts of this project. None of them is an option-pricing
Option-market terms used in this study
A contract giving the right to buy (call) or sell
(put) a stock at a set price before a set date.
Its price reflects how much movement the market
The exercise price written in the contract. Not a
The contract's end date; DTE is calendar days to
The price paid for the contract, in dollars.
"Premium share" is the fraction of premium on one
Best buy and sell quotes. The aggressor is the
side inferred to have initiated the trade; it is a
The level of future movement implied by option
prices. The surface is IV across strikes and
expiries; smile, skew, term slope, risk reversal
Measurements of the option market at the forecast
time: IV levels and the shape of the surface.
buy/sell split, sweeps, multileg trades, same-day
State comes from option prices; flow comes from option trades. The study
Sensitivities, trade types and market words
How an option's price responds to the stock price
(delta), how delta itself changes (gamma), and how
versions add these up over recent trades.
A proxy for the position held by market makers.
Hedging that position can move the stock; the
study measures a proxy, not actual dealer books.
Trading to offset an existing risk rather than to
bet; how easily a contract can be traded. Both can
create trades that carry no forecast.
A sweep executes one order across several
exchanges at once; a multileg trade combines
several contracts (a spread). Both are recorded
trade types, not signals by themselves.
Strike relative to the current stock price (strike
divided by spot); near one means at the money.
A session is one trading day, 9:30 to 16:00 New
York time. An origin is one forecast case: a
stock, a day and a minute (10:05 to 15:25, every
five minutes; 65 per stock per day).
Exchange-traded funds that track the S&P 500 and
Nasdaq-100 indices. Used as market controls, and
as two extra targets in the eight-asset extension.
Ticker symbols of Apple, Amazon, Meta, Microsoft,
prices; Unusual Whales supplies the option
Sensitivities and trade types are inputs; the study does not identify who
Measures and checks specific to variance forecasting
The sum of squared one-minute log returns over the
next interval. It is variance, not its square root
The loss used to score variance forecasts: y/f −
log(y/f) − 1. It punishes under-forecasting a big
move much more than over-forecasting a small one.
previous session's pattern; HAR combines past
variance over several time scales; HARQ adds a
Mean absolute error and root mean squared error,
in variance units. Reported as complements; QLIKE
The two model families. The linear model fits log
on the receipts); the trees are gradient-boosted
with leaves and stopping rounds chosen on earlier
Only records with a source timestamp at least 120
seconds before the forecast time are allowed. It
is a rule on source clocks, not proof of when a
Training rows whose outcome ends within 60 minutes
of validation or forecasting are excluded; the
first 60 sessions are reserved to build histories.
Groups of five consecutive sessions are resampled
9,999 times with a fixed seed; the interval
describes the estimated difference and the
one-sided test asks whether it improves at the 5 %
rule. Holm is the stricter correction for several
Follow-up checks: shuffled option flow should not
look better than nothing; stricter delays (300 and
Files that record inputs, outputs, times and
content hashes so that every number can be traced
